title: Manual tie-point coordinate validation
finding: Mismatched coordinate dimensions were accepted by the request model; a ragged list reached NumPy array construction in the route and raised an unhandled ValueError.
change: PointPair.source_point and PointPair.target_point now require exactly three coordinates at request validation. The API returns HTTP 422 for short or oversized point vectors before registration code runs.

test_first.before_fix: The malformed-dimension regression reproduced the unhandled ValueError; an earlier invalid-ID setup returned 404 before reaching the defect.

covered: two-coordinate and four-coordinate source tie points rejected
two-coordinate and four-coordinate target tie points rejected
manual Kabsch endpoint and coordinate frames
verification.latest_runner_cleanup: Passed after fixing lazy S2B_DATA_DIR initialization; no temporary test run directory remained and no cleanup warning was emitted.

acceptance.reason: This validates request shape only. Independent surveyed controls and RMSE below 10 mm remain unavailable.
